name: AS33 GotFriends
description: A high-performance 18 meter flapped glider including a self-launch motor, built-in winch launch, water ballast, and a comprehensive racing instrument panel. It features a real-time nav display, configurable vario with MacCready and Speed-to-Fly, and multifunction instruments that adapt based on flight inputs. Flap settings, ballast, and spoiler-linked braking are accurately modeled, with dynamic flight behavior reflecting ballast state and flap configuration.
